kinds.heading: Summary
kinds.hint: Two or three sentences on who you are and what you're aiming for.

kinds.heading: Experience
kinds.hint: Most recent first. Start bullets with a verb and include numbers where you can.
kinds.bullet_guidance: A job. Lead with what you did and the result for the employer, customers, patients, pupils or clients.

kinds.heading: Education
kinds.bullet_guidance: A course or degree. Show a module, grade, dissertation or final project, and what it taught you that the target role uses.

kinds.heading: Skills
kinds.hint: One skill per row, using the name employers put in job adverts.

kinds.heading: Projects
kinds.hint: Coursework, personal or work projects that show what you can do.
kinds.bullet_guidance: A project (coursework, personal or work). Say what was made or delivered, your part in it, how, and what came of it.

kinds.heading: Licenses & Certifications
kinds.hint: Licences, registrations and certificates, with the issuer and your licence or credential number.

kinds.heading: Achievements
kinds.hint: Results you're proud of that don't fit under a single job.
kinds.bullet_guidance: A stand-alone achievement. State the achievement and why it mattered, with its scale or result.

kinds.heading: Clinical Experience
kinds.hint: Placements, rotations and clinical roles. Include the ward or specialty and the patient groups you cared for.
kinds.bullet_guidance: A clinical placement or post. Show patient care delivered, caseload or acuity, procedures and assessments performed, the level of supervision, and safety or patient outcomes.

bullets.label: What you did
bullets.placeholder: Monitored vital signs for 8 post-operative patients per shift

kinds.heading: Teaching Experience
kinds.hint: Teaching posts, placements and courses you taught. Mention the age group or level and the subject.
kinds.bullet_guidance: A teaching role. Show who was taught (age, level, class size), what was planned or taught and how, and the effect on pupils' progress, results, attendance or engagement.

bullets.label: What you did
bullets.placeholder: Raised reading scores for a class of 28 through small-group phonics

kinds.heading: Internships
kinds.hint: Internships, placements, apprenticeships and work shadowing.
kinds.bullet_guidance: An internship. Show real responsibilities and what they contributed to the team, as for a job, without overstating seniority.

bullets.label: What you did
bullets.placeholder: Drafted weekly social posts that grew followers by 15%

kinds.heading: Volunteer Work
kinds.hint: Volunteering counts as experience. Describe it like a job.
kinds.bullet_guidance: A volunteer role. Show the people or cause served, what was organised or delivered, and transferable skills such as teamwork, care or leadership.

kinds.heading: Research
kinds.hint: Research projects, theses and lab or field work, with your role and methods.
kinds.bullet_guidance: Research work. Show the question, the methods and tools used, your contribution, and the findings, outputs (papers, datasets, talks) or funding it led to.

title.label: Project or role
title.placeholder: Doctoral research: soil microbiomes in drought

kinds.heading: Publications
kinds.hint: Use your field's citation style. Put your name in the author list.

title.label: Title
title.placeholder: Drought tolerance in wheat root systems

description.label: Authors and details
description.placeholder: Shah P., Jones A. Vol. 12, pp. 44-58

kinds.heading: Conferences & Presentations
kinds.hint: Talks, posters and panels you gave.

kinds.heading: Portfolio
kinds.hint: Pieces of work people can look at: designs, campaigns, writing, builds, photographs or case studies.

description.label: What it is and your part in it

kinds.heading: Training
kinds.hint: Courses, workshops and continuing professional development.

kinds.heading: Professional Memberships
kinds.hint: Professional bodies and associations you belong to.

kinds.heading: Awards
kinds.hint: Awards, honours, scholarships and prizes.

kinds.heading: Languages
kinds.hint: One language per row with how well you speak it.

kinds.heading: Extracurricular Activities
kinds.hint: Clubs, societies, sports teams and positions of responsibility.
kinds.bullet_guidance: A club, society or activity. Show leadership, organising, teamwork or commitment, and the result for the group.

bullets.label: What you did
bullets.placeholder: Organised fundraising that paid for new kit for 15 players

kinds.heading: Additional Information
kinds.hint: A section you name yourself.
kinds.bullet_guidance: An entry in a section the candidate named. Match the section's heading and keep the bullet factual and specific.

requirements.label: Summary
requirements.advice: Add 2-3 sentences on who you are and the role you want. Many ATS rank by it.

student.advice: Add 2-3 sentences on what you're studying, when you finish and the role you want. Many ATS rank by it.

career_changer.advice: Add 2-3 sentences on the field you're moving from, the role you want and the skills that carry over. Many ATS rank by it.

requirements.label: Experience
requirements.advice: Add work experience (or projects if you are early in your career).

student.advice: Add part-time jobs, placements, volunteering or projects. Employers hiring students expect these instead of a long career.

entry.advice: Add your jobs so far, including part-time work, placements, volunteering or projects.

career_changer.advice: Add your past roles. Your earlier career is experience too: its bullets should show the skills your new role needs.

requirements.label: Education
requirements.advice: Add your education. Most ATS filters check for it.

student.advice: Add your course, school and expected finish date. For students it's the first thing employers read.

requirements.label: Skills
requirements.advice: Add a Skills section. ATS keyword matching relies on it heavily.

role_requirement.advice: {role} roles usually screen for this. Add a {heading} section.

student.advice: {role} roles screen for this. Add a {heading} section, listing what you're working towards with the expected date.
